visualReview.notes: Inspected15 portable views: gold pierced saddle vessel, complete white diamond roof and oval opening, curved V supports, base entrances, sand bowl, hospitality bands, screens, cables and bounded podium are present. Master byte hash matches the preserved original.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected15 shared-material/placement views. Common painted-metal, concrete and membrane textures bind correctly; gold/cream color ranks hold and mapped ground trace sits within the retained source roof overhang. Shared fixture verifies flat-stage cutout, cache and unload restoration; actual surrounding grade is assessed using PMTiles preview.

mediumFiReview.notes: Inspected all31 final runtime views after fixing the missing underside and lower concourse enclosure. Four matched tiers retain vessel/roof/bowl proportions under noon/late, Economy/High and silhouette modes. Near levels show perforations, V legs, real stepped row impressions, pitch lines, roof underside/cables and screens; distant tiers deliberately merge these details. PMTiles-derived podium toes meet surrounding terrain.

geographicReview.notes: The inspected exterior picture supports the gold saddle vessel, pierced triangular skin, white diamond membrane and elongated roof opening. Retained mapped stadium/pitch controls set approximate anchor and heading; source roof and vessel dimensions are preserved rather than shrunk to the smaller ground trace. Standard viewer PMTiles working datum 5.335036814334491m controls surrounding ground and browser podium toes. A reversible bounded172m-radius opening exposes the reconstructed recessed bowl. Surrounding raw terrain is retained. Pitch/plaza levels, perimeter steps and orientation are approximate visualization, not survey.

fidelityReview.notes: Accepted medium-fi exterior approximation from inspected picture and standard PMTiles. Panel/seat/row inventories and cable/podium subdivision are interpreted; browser lower concourse is a closed simplified wall, not a full entrance/interior inventory. Depressed field/plaza levels are reconstructed; precise survey/engineering fidelity and physical-device timing are not claimed. Footprint replacement stays off.
